### Bug Description

Every `scene.reset()` logs one warning per recorder that runs in a background thread (`CSVFile`, `NPZFile`):

```
[Genesis] [WARNING] [CSVFileWriter] start_thread(): Processor thread already exists.
[Genesis] [WARNING] [NPZFileWriter] start_thread(): Processor thread already exists.
```

`RecorderManager.reset` calls `recorder.start()` on each recorder that is still alive, and `Recorder.start` calls `start_thread()` whenever `run_in_thread` is True. The thread is still running after a reset, so `start_thread` takes its warning branch. Partial resets (`scene.reset(envs_idx=...)`) take the same path, so an RL loop that resets finished environments gets these warnings at nearly every step. The recorded data is correct; only the log is affected.

### Steps to Reproduce

```python
import genesis as gs

gs.init(backend=gs.cpu)
scene = gs.Scene(show_viewer=False)
box = scene.add_entity(gs.morphs.Box(size=(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), pos=(0, 0, 1)))
scene.add_recorder(data_func=box.get_pos, rec_options=gs.recorders.CSVFile(filename="pos.csv"))
scene.add_recorder(data_func=box.get_pos, rec_options=gs.recorders.NPZFile(filename="pos.npz"))
scene.build()
scene.step()
scene.reset()  # one "Processor thread already exists." warning per recorder
scene.step()
scene.stop_recording()
```

### Expected Behavior

A reset keeps the running processing thread of a recorder and logs nothing.

### Relevant log output

```
[Genesis] [03:20:52] [WARNING] [CSVFileWriter] start_thread(): Processor thread already exists.
[Genesis] [03:20:52] [WARNING] [NPZFileWriter] start_thread(): Processor thread already exists.
```

### Environment

- OS: macOS 26 (arm64)
- GPU/CPU: Apple M-series, CPU backend
- Python 3.12, torch 2.14.1, quadrants 1.3.3

### Release version or Commit ID

b84599b (main)

### Additional Context

A one-line fix is to start the thread in `Recorder.start` only when none is running (`self._processor_thread is None`). I can open a PR.
new_candidates.title: Every scene.reset() warns 'Processor thread already exists.' for each threaded recorder
